```{r load_data, include=FALSE}
# Load minimal data
data_list <- load_minimal_data(include_survival = TRUE)
dat_combined <- data_list$dat_combined
ctdna_long <- data_list$ctdna_long
survival_data <- data_list$survival_data
```

```{r define_universe, include=FALSE}
# ==============================
# Universe: Patients who underwent cystectomy and had first ctDNA level 
# after surgery that was detectable
# ==============================

# Extract cystectomy date
surgery_date_cols <- names(dat_combined)[str_detect(names(dat_combined), regex("surgery.*1.*date|cystectomy.*date|first.*surgery.*date", ignore_case = TRUE))]
if (length(surgery_date_cols) == 0) {
  surgery_date_cols <- names(dat_combined)[str_detect(names(dat_combined), regex("definitive.*surgery|radical.*cystectomy", ignore_case = TRUE))]
}

cystectomy_patients <- dat_combined %>%
  select(patient_id, all_of(surgery_date_cols)) %>%
  mutate(
    cystectomy_date = if (length(surgery_date_cols) > 0) {
      as_date_safe(.data[[surgery_date_cols[1]]])
    } else {
      as.Date(NA)
    }
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(cystectomy_date)) %>%
  select(patient_id, cystectomy_date)

# Get first ctDNA after surgery (must be detectable)
first_post_surgery_ctdna <- ctdna_long %>%
  inner_join(cystectomy_patients, by = "patient_id") %>%
  filter(
    ctdna_date > cystectomy_date,
    ctdna_value > 0
  ) %>%
  arrange(patient_id, ctdna_date) %>%
  group_by(patient_id) %>%
  slice_head(n = 1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(patient_id, first_post_surgery_date = ctdna_date, first_post_surgery_value = ctdna_value)

# Define universe
universe <- first_post_surgery_ctdna %>%
  left_join(cystectomy_patients, by = "patient_id") %>%
  mutate(
    days_from_surgery = as.numeric(first_post_surgery_date - cystectomy_date),
    months_from_surgery = days_from_surgery / 30.44
  )

cat("Universe size: n =", nrow(universe), "\n")
cat("Median time from surgery to first detectable ctDNA:", round(median(universe$months_from_surgery, na.rm = TRUE), 1), "months\n")
cat("Population studied: Patients who underwent cystectomy and had first ctDNA level after surgery that was detectable\n")
```

```{r extract_outcomes, include=FALSE}
# Extract survival outcomes
death_date_cols <- names(dat_combined)[str_detect(names(dat_combined), regex("^death_date$|death.*date$", ignore_case = TRUE)) & 
                                       !str_detect(names(dat_combined), regex("cause|reason", ignore_case = TRUE))]
survival_cols <- names(dat_combined)[str_detect(names(dat_combined), regex("last.*follow.*up.*date|follow.*up.*date", ignore_case = TRUE)) & 
                                     !str_detect(names(dat_combined), regex("death", ignore_case = TRUE))]
alive_cols <- names(dat_combined)[str_detect(names(dat_combined), regex("^alive_yes_no$|alive.*yes.*no", ignore_case = TRUE))]

outcomes <- universe %>%
  left_join(
    dat_combined %>%
      select(patient_id, all_of(c(death_date_cols, survival_cols, alive_cols))),
    by = "patient_id"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    death_date = if (length(death_date_cols) > 0) {
      as_date_safe(.data[[death_date_cols[1]]])
    } else {
      as.Date(NA)
    },
    last_fu_date = if (length(survival_cols) > 0) {
      as_date_safe(.data[[survival_cols[1]]])
    } else {
      as.Date(NA)
    },
    alive_status = if (length(alive_cols) > 0) {
      case_when(
        str_detect(tolower(as.character(.data[[alive_cols[1]]])), "yes|y|1") ~ "Yes",
        str_detect(tolower(as.character(.data[[alive_cols[1]]])), "no|n|0") ~ "No",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
    } else {
      NA_character_
    },
    os_time = as.numeric(pmax(last_fu_date, death_date, na.rm = TRUE) - first_post_surgery_date),
    os_event = case_when(
      !is.na(death_date) ~ 1,
      alive_status == "No" ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ 0
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(os_time), os_time > 0)
```

```{r descriptive_table}
# Descriptive table
desc_table <- outcomes %>%
  summarise(
    N = n(),
    `First Post-Surgery ctDNA (median, IQR)` = paste0(
      round(median(first_post_surgery_value, na.rm = TRUE), 2), 
      " (", 
      round(quantile(first_post_surgery_value, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE), 2), 
      "-", 
      round(quantile(first_post_surgery_value, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE), 2), 
      ")"
    ),
    `Time from Surgery (median, IQR months)` = paste0(
      round(median(months_from_surgery, na.rm = TRUE), 1), 
      " (", 
      round(quantile(months_from_surgery, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE), 1), 
      "-", 
      round(quantile(months_from_surgery, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE), 1), 
      ")"
    ),
    `Events` = sum(os_event, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Median OS (months)` = round(median(os_time, na.rm = TRUE) / 30.44, 1),
    `1-year OS %` = round(100 * (1 - sum(os_event[os_time <= 365.25], na.rm = TRUE) / sum(os_time <= 365.25, na.rm = TRUE)), 1)
  ) %>%
  kable(caption = "Universe Characteristics") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = TRUE)

desc_table
```

```{r survival_by_ctdna_level}
# Survival curves by ctDNA level quartiles
outcomes_quartiles <- outcomes %>%
  mutate(
    ctdna_quartile = ntile(first_post_surgery_value, 4),
    ctdna_quartile_label = case_when(
      ctdna_quartile == 1 ~ "Q1 (Lowest)",
      ctdna_quartile == 2 ~ "Q2",
      ctdna_quartile == 3 ~ "Q3",
      ctdna_quartile == 4 ~ "Q4 (Highest)"
    )
  )

surv_fit <- survfit(Surv(os_time, os_event) ~ ctdna_quartile_label, data = outcomes_quartiles)

p <- ggsurvplot(
  surv_fit,
  data = outcomes_quartiles,
  pval = TRUE,
  conf.int = FALSE,
  risk.table = TRUE,
  xlab = "Time from First Post-Surgery ctDNA (days)",
  ylab = "Overall Survival Probability",
  title = "Overall Survival by First Post-Surgery ctDNA Quartile",
  legend.title = "ctDNA Quartile",
  legend.labs = c("Q1 (Lowest)", "Q2", "Q3", "Q4 (Highest)")
)

p$plot
```

```{r cox_model_ctdna_level}
# Cox model: association with ctDNA level
cox_model <- coxph(Surv(os_time, os_event) ~ log(first_post_surgery_value + 1), data = outcomes)
cox_summary <- summary(cox_model)

results_table <- tibble(
  `Variable` = "log(First Post-Surgery ctDNA + 1)",
  `HR (95% CI)` = paste0(
    round(exp(cox_summary$coefficients[1, "coef"]), 2),
    " (",
    round(exp(cox_summary$conf.int[1, "lower .95"]), 2),
    "-",
    round(exp(cox_summary$conf.int[1, "upper .95"]), 2),
    ")"
  ),
  `P-value` = ifelse(cox_summary$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"] < 0.001, 
                      "<0.001", 
                      round(cox_summary$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"], 3))
) %>%
  kable(caption = "Cox Model: First Post-Surgery ctDNA Level and Overall Survival") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = TRUE)

results_table
```

```{r scatter_plot}

  ggplot(aes(x = log(first_post_surgery_value + 1), y = os_time, color = factor(os_event))) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
```
